comment: Which secret would hurt most if your CI runner leaked it: cloud keys, GitHub tokens, npm tokens, SSH keys, Kubernetes creds, or Vault access?
Windows Codex setup tradeoff: elevated sandbox if admin setup is available, unelevated only as a weaker fallback, and WSL2 when the repo needs Linux-native behavior. What would you allow by default?
What would you spend the extra 50% on: Opus planning, longer agents, or fewer interruptions?
